The Anatomy of a Good Prompt

Role ↓ Context ↓ Objective ↓ Input ↓ Tasks ↓ Constraints ↓ Output Format ↓ Validation

One Formula to Remember

Role + Context + Objective + Input + Tasks + Constraints + Output Format + Validation

Universal Prompt Template

1. Define the role and expertise level required.
2. Provide background context about the task domain.
3. State the objective in one clear sentence.
4. List the input data or documents available.
5. Break the work into numbered subtasks.
6. Specify constraints, tone, and formatting rules.
7. Describe the expected output format.
8. Add validation or self-check instructions.
9. Include examples of good and bad outputs.
10. Specify edge cases to handle.
11. Review and refine the final prompt.

Building a Professional Prompt

Follow the anatomy above when constructing prompts for QA workflows.
